formula: Does / Did + X + come at the cost of + noun / V-ing?

formulas.formula: Does / Did + X + come at the cost of + noun / V-ing?

example: Faster production often comes at the cost of lower quality.
exampleZh: 更快的生產速度往往以質素下降為代價。

examples.en: Faster production often comes at the cost of lower quality.
examples.zh: 更快的生產速度往往以質素下降為代價。
examples.highlight: Faster production often comes at the cost of lower quality.

rules.zh: 在 come at the cost of 中，of 是介詞，後面可接表示品質、私隱、公眾信任或工人安全的名詞和名詞片語；也可接動詞的 -ing 形式，表示失去顧客、削減培訓或忽略細節。不可直接接動詞原形，也不可改成不定詞或刪去介詞。
rules.en: “of” at the cost of quality at the cost of privacy at the cost of public trust at the cost of workers’ safety at the cost of losing customers at the cost of reducing staff training at the cost of working longer hours at the cost of ignoring important details at the cost of lose customers at the cost of to lose customers at the cost to lose customers

rules.zh: 通常代表得到的好處或成果在以下句子中：【Faster production comes at the cost of lower quality.】 得到的好處：faster production 被犧牲的事物：quality 兩者的位置不可隨意倒轉。這句並非原句的另一種寫法，而是表達了不同的取捨關係。
rules.en: X Faster production comes at the cost of lower quality. Lower quality comes at the cost of faster production

rules.zh: 這個句型不只表示金錢上的代價詞語【“cost”】可以是：金錢（money）；時間（time）；健康（health）；質素（quality）；安全（safety）；私隱（privacy）；自由（freedom）；信任（trust）；人際關係（relationships）；機會（opportunities）。
rules.en: Cost is not limited to money. It may refer to time, health, quality, safety, privacy, freedom, trust, relationships or opportunities.

rules.zh: 必須存在真正的取捨關係這個句型並不只是表示兩件事情同時發生。不適合：【The shop opened at nine, and it rained in the afternoon.】 商店九時開門，而下午下雨。 兩件事情之間沒有明顯的犧牲或取捨關係。適合：【The shop extended its opening hours, but the staff had less time to rest.】 商店延長了營業時間，但員工的休息時間減少了。 延長營業時間是以減少員工休息時間為代價。
rules.en: The shop opened at nine, and it rained in the afternoon. The shop extended its opening hours, but the staff had less time to rest. The longer opening hours came at the cost of giving the staff less time to rest.

rules.zh: 保留原句的可能性和語氣原句使用 may，答案也不應變成肯定事實。錯誤答案把「可能」變成了「必然」。
rules.en: Source: Greater safety may require people to give up some freedom. Greater safety may come at the cost of some freedom. Greater safety comes at the cost of some freedom.

rules.zh: 不一定緊接在第一個主語後面目標表達可以出現在：主句疑問句條件子句關係子句子句（that）；子句（whether）；詞語【seem to】或 be likely to 之後因此，不應只尋找一個固定答案位置。
rules.en: The target expression need not immediately follow the first subject. It may occur in a main clause, question, conditional or relative clause, a that- or whether-clause, or after seem to and be likely to.

benefits.zh: 清楚表達「有得必有失」這個句型可以立即告訴讀者，一項改善或好處並非毫無代價。快速送貨以減少仔細檢查為代價。 讀者可以清楚看到：得到了甚麼；同時犧牲了甚麼。
benefits.en: Faster delivery comes at the cost of careful checking.

benefits.zh: 比單純使用 but 更準確一般說法：【The service is faster, but it is less reliable.】 服務更快，但可靠性較低。 使用目標句型：【Faster service comes at the cost of reliability.】 更快的服務以可靠性為代價。 第二句不只表示兩項事實相反，還清楚說明兩者存在取捨關係。
benefits.en: The service is faster, but it is less reliable. Faster service comes at the cost of reliability.

benefits.zh: 適合分析決定和政策在作文、報告、辯論和簡報中，學生經常需要分析一項決定的利弊。這個句型可以幫助你解釋：公司為了降低成本而犧牲了甚麼；科技為了增加便利而犧牲了甚麼；政策為了提高安全而限制了甚麼；個人為了取得成功而放棄了甚麼。
benefits.en: The structure supports analysis of decisions and policies by identifying what a company, technology, policy or individual sacrifices in order to reduce costs, increase convenience, improve safety or achieve success.

benefits.zh: 令論點更完整學生有時只會說：【This is good.】 使用這個句型，可以直接把好處和代價連接起來：【The lower price comes at the cost of poorer materials.】 較低的價格以較差的物料為代價。 論點會更加具體，也更容易理解。
benefits.en: This is good. However, there is a disadvantage. The lower price comes at the cost of poorer materials.

benefits.zh: 可以用來反對錯誤的「二選一」否定形式可以表示兩項好處不一定互相衝突：【Efficiency does not have to come at the cost of fairness.】 提升效率不一定要以犧牲公平為代價。 這類句子適合用來提出更平衡的意見，而不是假設所有改善都必須造成損失。
benefits.en: Efficiency does not have to come at the cost of fairness.

benefits.zh: 能靈活放入不同句型你可以使用：【comes；came；has come；may come；should not come；Does... come?；If... comes...；which comes...】 因此，學生不只是記住一句固定句子，而是可以在不同說話和寫作情境中運用同一個核心表達。
benefits.en: comes came has come may come should not come Does... come? If... comes... which comes... whether...

questions.prompt: Some schools seem to improve examination results only by reducing creative learning.
questions.promptZh: 有些學校似乎只有減少創意學習，才能改善考試成績。
questions.answer: In some schools, better examination results seem to come at the cost of creative learning.
questions.answerZh: 在有些學校，較佳的考試成績似乎是以創意學習為代價。
questions.highlight: In some schools, better examination results seem to come at the cost of creative learning.

questions.prompt: The extra security is reassuring, but it makes everyone wait longer.
questions.promptZh: 額外的保安措施令人安心，但令所有人等候更長時間。
questions.answer: The extra security, while reassuring, comes at the cost of longer waiting times.
questions.answerZh: 額外的保安措施雖然令人安心，卻以更長的等候時間為代價。
questions.highlight: The extra security, while reassuring, comes at the cost of longer waiting times.

questions.prompt: It remains unclear whether the organisation can expand without reducing service quality.
questions.promptZh: 該機構能否在不降低服務質素的情況下擴展，目前仍不清楚。
questions.answer: Whether expansion comes at the cost of service quality remains unclear.
questions.answerZh: 擴展會否以服務質素為代價，目前仍不清楚。
questions.highlight: Whether expansion comes at the cost of service quality remains unclear.

questions.prompt: The policy was implemented, but public trust was sacrificed. It is now being reviewed.
questions.promptZh: 這項政策得以實施，但公眾信任卻被犧牲。當局現正檢討這項政策。
questions.answer: The policy, which has come at the cost of public trust, is now being reviewed.
questions.answerZh: 這項政策是以公眾信任為代價，現正接受檢討。
questions.highlight: The policy, which has come at the cost of public trust, is now being reviewed.

questions.prompt: Any increase in the city’s speed may require sacrificing quiet public spaces.
questions.promptZh: 城市任何速度上的提升，都可能需要犧牲寧靜的公共空間。
questions.answer: Any gains the city makes in speed may come at the cost of losing quiet public spaces.
questions.answerZh: 城市在速度方面取得的任何提升，都可能以失去寧靜的公共空間為代價。
questions.highlight: Any gains the city makes in speed may come at the cost of losing quiet public spaces.

questions.prompt: The committee must decide whether saving money now will weaken the organisation in the long term.
questions.promptZh: 委員會必須決定，現在節省金錢會否削弱機構的長遠應變能力。
questions.answer: The committee must decide whether short-term savings will come at the cost of long-term resilience.
questions.answerZh: 委員會必須決定，短期節省會否以長遠應變能力為代價。
questions.highlight: The committee must decide whether short-term savings will come at the cost of long-term resilience.

questions.prompt: Remote work offers flexibility, but this advantage may require teams to accept weaker relationships.
questions.promptZh: 遙距工作帶來靈活性，但這項好處可能需要團隊接受較薄弱的人際關係。
questions.answer: Although remote work offers flexibility, that flexibility can come at the cost of weaker team relationships.
questions.answerZh: 雖然遙距工作帶來靈活性，但這種靈活性可能以較薄弱的團隊關係為代價。
questions.highlight: Although remote work offers flexibility, that flexibility can come at the cost of weaker team relationships.

questions.prompt: The proposal looks simple only because it ignores important details.
questions.promptZh: 這項建議看似簡單，只是因為它忽略了重要細節。
questions.answer: The apparent simplicity of the proposal may come at the cost of ignoring important details.
questions.answerZh: 這項建議表面上的簡單，可能是以忽略重要細節為代價。
questions.highlight: The apparent simplicity of the proposal may come at the cost of ignoring important details.

questions.prompt: We should never improve a system by silencing the people most affected by it.
questions.promptZh: 我們絕不應透過令受影響最深的人噤聲來改善制度。
questions.answer: No improvement should come at the cost of silencing the people most affected by it.
questions.answerZh: 任何改善都不應以令受影響最深的人噤聲為代價。
questions.highlight: No improvement should come at the cost of silencing the people most affected by it.

questions.prompt: The new timetable seems to work only because teachers have been given less preparation time.
questions.promptZh: 新時間表似乎能夠運作，只是因為教師獲得的備課時間減少了。
questions.answer: The new timetable seems to have come at the cost of giving teachers less preparation time.
questions.answerZh: 新時間表似乎是以減少教師的備課時間為代價。
questions.highlight: The new timetable seems to have come at the cost of giving teachers less preparation time.

questions.prompt: Users need to understand the trade-off when a convenient service requires them to sacrifice security.
questions.promptZh: 當便利的服務要求用戶犧牲安全時，用戶需要明白其中的取捨。
questions.answer: When convenience comes at the cost of security, users need to understand the trade-off.
questions.answerZh: 當便利要以安全為代價時，用戶需要明白其中的取捨。
questions.highlight: When convenience comes at the cost of security, users need to understand the trade-off.

questions.prompt: The hospital must not serve patients faster by treating them less carefully.
questions.promptZh: 醫院絕不能透過降低照顧病人的細心程度來加快服務。
questions.answer: The hospital’s faster service must not come at the cost of treating patients less carefully.
questions.answerZh: 醫院加快服務絕不能以降低照顧病人的細心程度為代價。
questions.highlight: The hospital’s faster service must not come at the cost of treating patients less carefully.

questions.prompt: We should seriously discuss whether the technology has produced its benefits only by weakening human skills.
questions.promptZh: 我們應認真討論，這項科技是否只有削弱人類技能，才能帶來種種好處。
questions.answer: Whether the technology’s benefits have come at the cost of weakening human skills deserves serious discussion.
questions.answerZh: 這項科技帶來的好處是否以削弱人類技能為代價，值得認真討論。
questions.highlight: Whether the technology’s benefits have come at the cost of weakening human skills deserves serious discussion.
